thread:
taylor: Quick planning—need a concise recruitment and gating plan for the 6-week design partner program. Target 9 partners (mix hosted+private). Main ask: how strict should launch gates be vs speed of onboarding?

samir: Suggest tight tech gates but flexible business gates. Tech: integration ping within 10 days, perf baseline run, and telemetry enabled. Business: willingness to run a short pilot + designate an internal owner.

evan: Ops note: private infra capacity ~3 concurrent full runs. Recommend waves of 3 with 1 reserved slot for hotfix smoke tests. Stagger by 2 weeks to keep evals independent.

rachel: On success metrics: (1) integration started <=10d, (2) weekly automated eval pass rate >=90% on partner control set, (3) partner satisfaction >=7/10 at week6, (4) at least one measurable product outcome (e.g., latency reduction or accuracy gain).

taylor: Good. How about incentives? Credits + published case study + 3 implementation-hours grant for top 2 partners? That usually lowers friction.

samir: Solutions can do 3 grants. Add priority bug triage and a dedicated office-hour slot per partner for first 3 weeks.

evan: Telemetry requirement: partners must send anonymized request_id + sample traces. We'll provide a client snippet and a telemetry checklist. No raw PII.

rachel: Legal: regulated partners require DPA + data-flow diagram before we enable private evals. Mark them "pending-legal" on intake.

taylor: Recruitment mix proposal: 55% existing active hosted customers, 25% platform/on-prem interested, 20% new logos. Also reserve one slot for a regulated candidate if legal clears.

samir: Intake scoring idea: 6 quick fields (impact, integration complexity, infra effort, timeline, product-fit, legal risk). Auto-accept high scores, manual-review mid. Make scores visible in the intake sheet.

evan: Quality guardrail: run 12 deterministic prompts weekly and compute output-drift. If drift >6% for 2 consecutive weeks open an "eval incident" and fall back to stable model.

rachel: Stop criteria: pause invites if >40% partners miss integration kickoff by week2 or if more than 30% trigger remediation plans simultaneously.

taylor: Action items: 1) taylor: final recruitment selector + vertical targets (due EOD) 2) samir: reserve ops slots + wave schedule (due Tue) 3) evan: telemetry snippet + eval prompts template (due Tue) 4) rachel: legal check for regulated slot + intake flag (due Wed) 5) intake-bot: attach intake link when ready.

intake-bot: Intake form URL will be posted to the channel once created: https://redwood.internal/dp/intake-microbeta

taylor: I'll synthesize and post a one-pager. Keep the invite short and explicit about expected time commitment. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
